statement: Between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-15, the United States and Iran announce a ceasefire, truce, or formal end to hostilities, confirmed by a government statement or by at least two of Reuters, AP, or AFP.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters, AP, or AFP report a US-Iran ceasefire, truce, or hostilities-end announcement dated between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-15; adjudicated 2026-10-19. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No US-Iran ceasefire, truce, or hostilities-end announcement dated within the window is confirmed by Reuters, AP, or AFP as of the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
